checks.detail: asynchronous -> synchronous switch is observable and was not hand-placed: tau starts at eps = [0.02, 0.03], rises monotonically (min increment 7.6e-06) to [0.982 0.988], and t_switch (max_i tau_i >= 0.5) = 2.800 s lands inside the pre-declared window [1, 5] s.  The pair starts approaching the learned boundary at t_approach = 0.020 s, i.e. well before the switch; the two are reported side by side, not forced to coincide

end-to-end with the learned boundary in the QP: min_t Gamma_raw = 2.0700, boundary crossings = 0, the (17d) row is active on 53% of the steps.  Reported with its cost: the hard row makes the QP INFEASIBLE on 370 of 800 steps (46%), every one of them attributed to the row -- the same QP without (17d) is OPTIMAL on all 370.  Those steps are frozen at qdot = 0 (`row_policy='freeze'`), so this number alone cannot be attributed to the row steering the arms; P10.7 measures the counterfactual
matched SCA-off control (same initial state, same object motion, same dt, same solver): min_t Gamma_raw = -2.3147 and 534 boundary crossings, versus 2.0700 and 0 with SCA on
removing the SCA row is detected as a defect: the crossing counter goes from 0 to 534 and min_t Gamma_raw from 2.0700 to -2.3147

counterfactual on the 368 infeasible steps (row dropped instead of frozen): min_t Gamma_raw = 1.2400 and 0 boundary crossings, against 2.0700 / 0 for the freeze policy and -2.3147 / 534 with the row switched off entirely.  The row still carries the guarantee without the freeze; the freeze only adds conservatism.

sub-task consistency: the e2e tau agrees with an independent RK4 integration of Eq.(8) (driven by the recorded G) to 8.5e-04, the Gamma history is reproduced from the recorded joints to 0.0e+00, and the per-step KKT residual stays at 1.6e-14 (T08 reported 8.3e-16 on its own fixture).  A pointwise Gamma(t) comparison against T08 is NOT meaningful -- different arms, task and horizon -- so only the criterion (crossings 0 on / > 0 off) is compared, and T08's numbers are reported for the record: min 2.181 / 0 / 656

Theorem-3 identity at every QP solution: max |psi - Y^T U| = 9.095e-13 against max psi = 2.446e+04 (relative 3.7e-17).  The active-set solution satisfies P(u - Mu - b) = u, so Y^T U must collapse onto psi and Vdot onto 0 instantaneously; this is the (21a) assembly check, not a trajectory claim.

the plan's Theorem-3 ledger does NOT close and the reason is fully accounted for: int Y^T U dt - Delta V - int psi dt = 4.661e-02 with Delta V = -4.661e-02, so residual + Delta V = 2.764e-14 (0.00% of int|Y^T U| dt = 3.287e+02).  Delta V is the quasi-static jump of the multiplier vector when the QP is re-solved, not a missing term: Theorem 3 governs the flow (20), and this loop replaces that flow by a sequence of fixed points of a time-varying LVI.  The other variant (P_in = xdot^R . f, S = 0.5||separation||^2) is reported and NOT gated: residual = -3.284e+02 (215161% of its scale).  Neither number is an energy balance.

pinning tau == 1 or tau == 0 removes the switch entirely (t_switch is None in both runs, against 2.800 s with Eq.(8)): the asynchronous->synchronous transition is produced by the logistic field, not by a schedule

the end-to-end result is gated by the sub-tasks: on disk T01-T08 are 8/8 PASS, and run_all.evaluate_gates returns BLOCKED_BY_UPSTREAM for G4 when T08 is doctored to FAIL, so an e2e number can never paper over a failing sub-task

lambda = 0 changes the outcome: min_t Gamma_raw 4.2235 vs 2.0700, crossings 0 vs 0, infeasible steps 594 vs 370.  The direction is NOT 'crossings rise' -- on this fixture the lambda = 0 cone stops the approach earlier, which is the same finding as T08/N8.2 (docs/DECISIONS.md D016)
dt doubled: min_t Gamma_raw 2.0700 -> 2.0600 and t_switch 2.800 -> 2.820 s, so the integration step is really in the loop and the reported numbers are not step-size independent
